name: Eddie Hales
source: Once led a great bandit gang, but was ultimately wiped out by the knights of Rugalant. Seeking revenge, he infiltrates the country and plans to cause chaos from the inside. He sought by exploiting the princess' naive nature to accomplish his goal...
